p: day: In which you shall rest from all bodily work.
hearted among you shall come: See Ex 28:3.
covering: Which hung before the mercyseat so it could not be seen.
cloths of service: Such as belong to the service of the tabernacle.
wise hearted did spin with their: Who were witty and expert.
whose heart stirred them up in: That is, who were good spinners.
by the hand of Moses: Using Moses as a minister of it.
of work: Belonging to graving or carving, or such like.
